about: What a model's tokens cost, for the chat's estimate. A price applies to one model id on one provider at one base URL; a connection that matches none shows tokens only. Rates are per million tokens, in the currency named: input is the prompt read without a cache, cache_read the prompt read from the cache, cache_write the prompt written to it, output the reply. The person's bill is the provider's; this is an estimate.

sources.prices: Anthropic's first-party API rates as published on its pricing page, read on 3 November 2026. cache_write is the 5-minute cache's rate, 1.25 times input: the Anthropic backend marks its cache breakpoints ephemeral, which is the 5-minute cache. Claude Haiku 5.5 is not listed because its rate changes with the prompt's size (above 100 000 tokens), which a per-model rate cannot express. Other providers and local models have no entry, so the chat shows their tokens without a price.
